title: Cumbal (Narino)
description: Datasets registered under the 'Cumbal (Narino)' Living Landscape (2 item(s)). Spatial extent derives from the canonical landscape delineation (2026-07-21); the simplified boundary is published as this collection's 'boundary' asset. National-coverage member items can widen the extent beyond the boundary.
mosaic:bbox_note: Bbox derived from the canonical delineation shapefile (dissolved, EPSG:4326), union-ed with member-item locator boxes.

links.title: Crop fields (2023)  focus on 	Potatoes, Oca, Mashua and andean fruit trees

boundary.title: Landscape boundary (canonical delineation, simplified, EPSG:4326)
boundary.mosaic:source: Nine veredas of the Cumbal indigenous reserve area (Tasmag, Quilismal, Boyera, Cuaical, Cuaspud Grande, Llano de Piedras, Cuetial, Guan, San Martin-Miraflores), layer 'Cumbal_veredas_wgs84' compiled by Javier Ochoa (CIP). Original source to be confirmed.
boundary.mosaic:attribution: Vereda boundaries compiled by J. Ochoa (CIP) for the CGIAR Science Program on Multifunctional Landscapes; original source to be confirmed.
